items.clause: close_initial.py recomputes study.fingerprint over both complete production roots, compares stock versus current over the union of keys, and requires changed == exactly the approved added paths before study.capsule seals the initial source.

close_session.py recomputes the same full fingerprint, compares shared initial versus final over the union of keys, and requires changed <= approved added paths before study.capsule seals final source.

study.collect recomputes the complete fingerprint against source_seal at entry, again before each platform SDK collection and after collection; study.capsule stores all fingerprinted source bytes and the exact files mapping.

limits: These gates establish preservation of pre-recorded bytes and change scope within the declared production roots, not runtime regression testing, files outside those roots, or computed visual properties. A gate failure or missing receipt remains unverified; two-file source review cannot replace these gates.
